what: 20-question smoke of the thinking arm on OUR fine-tuned checkpoint (conn4e5), real FRAME questions and frames, on-pod. Aggregates only -- no generation text left the pod (DUA).
engine: screen_engine / HF transformers, SEQUENTIAL, bf16 merge, enforce_latency=True

budget_2048.CONFOUNDED: max_trace_chars == 4000 == answer_char_cap EXACTLY. The CHAR cap truncated the string before </think> could appear. It was calibrated for a 512-token budget (~2000 chars) and not re-calibrated when the budget rose to 2048 (~8000 chars). So this truncation rate mixes 'the model did not close' with 'our cap cut it off' and CANNOT be decomposed. My error, stated rather than interpreted away.

what_IS_established.the_parser_works: Every generation that closed the tag yielded an answer under 40 chars -- 8/8 and 14/14. mean chars RAW 1822-2663 vs PARSED 6-8 is the signature of the defect the extractor fixes: without it the judge scores the TRACE.
what_IS_established.sequential_eval_is_infeasible: 30 s/question at 512 tokens, 115.6 s at 2048. The 626-question arm would take 5.2 h (with 64 % truncated = garbage) or 20 h (~$42). The rung as designed cannot be run.
what_IS_established.the_bottleneck_is_OUR_HARNESS_not_thinki: The same model, same thinking, through vLLM continuous batching measures 1.33 s/question (RESULTS_batched_thinking.json). Our eval path is ~100x slower than production because screen_engine generates one question at a time in HF transformers.

what_is_NOT_established.does_our_SFT_break_thinking: Unknown. The base 27B closed in a median of 177 tokens on synthetic questions; this checkpoint truncates far more on real ones. That could be the fine-tuning OR the harder real prompts -- two variables moved at once, and the char-cap confound sits on top.
what_is_NOT_established.does_thinking_help_accuracy: Not measured. enforce_latency=True marks 22/22 responses incorrect on the clock alone, so no accuracy read from this smoke means anything.

decision_required: Rung 43's eval must be rewritten for vLLM batched (~14 min for 626 questions at the measured rate), or the rung closes as NOT MEASURABLE with the current harness. It must NOT be reported as a verdict about reasoning.
